name: Seraphine Vael
greetings: The runes are awake. Bring me something worth binding.
Bookshelves listen. Fifteen of them, and a table will offer you anything I can.
Two tomes alike become one stronger. That is how the great enchants are made.
Ultimate magic is jealous. An item will hold only one.
Salvage what you can't use. Runic Dust feeds the strongest work.
Sneak and speak to me again if you want spell scrolls for a wand.
